ValidationRule.description: Reference must be exactly one of invoice, order or none, matching the reference type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(ReferenceType__c, "INVOICE"), ISBLANK(ReferenceInvoice__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(ReferenceType__c, "ORDER"), ISBLANK(ReferenceOrder__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(ReferenceType__c, "NONE"), OR(NOT(ISBLANK(ReferenceInvoice__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(ReferenceOrder__c)))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(ReferenceInvoice__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(ReferenceOrder__c))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Choose exactly one reference that matches the reference type.
